description: This file defines an interface class 'IOcdmSessionClient' for handling CDM session events such as processing challenges, key updates, and errors within the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for callbacks related to CDM session management.

classes.name: IOcdmSessionClient
classes.description: An interface class for handling CDM session events such as challenge processing, key updates, and error notifications.

methods.name: onProcessChallenge
methods.description: Callback for processing challenge data, providing URL, challenge buffer, and challenge length.

methods.name: onKeyUpdated
methods.description: Notification of a key status change, providing key ID buffer and its length.

methods.name: onAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Notification that all key statuses have been updated.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Notification of an error message related to the CDM session.
